The dictionary Description should be corrected to name the GSE-10 (Chinese adaptation, Zhang & Schwarzer 1995). Not a mismatch -- the name was simply uninformative. (2) MAPPING: item codes ARE the source column names (SCALES dict maps Q25_Row1..Q25_Row10 straight through; no positional assignment, no rename), and the variable labels carry the item wording, so mapping_basis=data_labels and Step 5b is exempt at the derivation level (core model 3, pattern 1). (4) ANCHORS: the administered anchors (不符合 / 有点不符合 / 符合 / 非常符合, a fit format) are NOT the GSE's published anchors (1 = Not at all true ... 4 = Exactly true). The .sav's value labels are shipped verbatim and no canonical anchors were substituted. (5) INSTRUCTIONS: '下面的情景，请根据您的实际情况快速作答' is the Q25 block prompt embedded in the Q25_Row1 variable label (prefixed '25、' and joined to item 1 by an em dash); the numbering and the block prompt were stripped from item 1's item_text and the prompt recorded once in instructions. Attribution only -- no fee, no non-commercial, no-derivatives or no-redistribution clause anywhere on selfscal.htm, engscal.htm or the FAQ. Per the 2026-09-10 rule a round may never write a 'ship' row, so no instrument_rights_register.csv row was added; the GSE is escalated to the human as a ship-shaped case.
